title: Trip Costs
description: Every numeric figure from the spreadsheet organized by category — flights, lodging, safari, park fees, visas, insurance, dining, permits, souvenirs. Includes amounts, currency, paid/owing status, and payment method. 20+ rows covering the complete financial picture.

category.description: Cost category: flights, lodging, safari, park-fees, visas, insurance, dining, permits, souvenirs

per_person.description: True if the amount is per person; false if total for 2 pax

quantity.description: Multiplier — e.g. 2 for 2 travelers, used to compute line total

paid.description: Amount already paid in this currency

owing.description: Amount still owing in this currency

payment_method.description: How to pay: cash (post-2009 USD), Pesapal, credit card, bank transfer, online portal name

notes.description: Context: booking reference, URL, deadlines, restrictions
